description: This file defines a React functional component 'HabitCard' used to display and interact with a habit in a habit-tracking application. It manages state for UI interactions, renders habit details, streak information, and toggles for daily completion status.

methods.name: HabitCard
methods.description: React component that displays a habit with toggles for the last 7 days and streak info, allowing toggling completion and deletion of the habit.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Handles toggling the completion status of a habit for a specific day by calling external data client functions.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deleting the habit after user confirmation.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks if a given date string corresponds to today.
